title: Truth Seeker
style: Phonk-inflected trap with a grimy mid-tempo bounce, sliding 808s, clipped hat patterns, and eerie minor-key synth stabs; verse rides sparse with dry close-mic vocals, pre-chorus tightens with whispered doubles and rising risers, chorus hits with gang shouts and hard left-right ad-libs. Reverse swells, tape stops, and a filtered data-buzz transition into the hook. Dark, punchy, and glossy-grit mixed., raw, low, fresh
